export.backupDescription: Review database backup recommendations and download tenant data snapshots.
export.exportDescription: Download clean, sanitized CSV or JSON exports of your catalog, sales, and customers.
export.backupArchitectureBody1: DukaanOS uses a resilient PostgreSQL 16 database. Application-level JSON exports below provide portable catalog and ledger records. For full disaster recovery (including indexes, foreign keys, and audit sequences), automated nightly database snapshots or infrastructure-level
export.securityNote: Security Sanitized: Password hashes, external API tokens, and camera credentials are automatically excluded from export files.
